mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.status, r.view_count, COUNT(rcoll.id) AS collection_count, r.create_time FROM route_collection rcoll LEFT JOIN travel_route r ON rcoll.route_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_collection rcoll2 ON r.id = rcoll2.route_id AND rcoll2.deleted = 0 WHERE rcoll.user_id = #{userId} AND rcoll.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY rcoll.create_time DESC
